title: Acquisition Onboarding Manager
description:
ISP Acquisition Onboarding Manager (OBM)

Reporting to: Senior Acquisition Onboarding Manager

Location: Remote, Brazil with travel to acquired schools within LATAM region as required

Purpose of the role

As an Acquisition Onboarding Manager (OBM) at ISP, you play a pivotal role in the successful integration of newly acquired schools into the ISP group, from completion through to a fully onboarded, compliant and operationally ready.

This is a dynamic and hands-on role that combines PMO discipline with hands-on delivery execution. You will not only oversee the integration plan but also actively contribute to the completion of critical tasks, particularly in time-sensitive areas such as Finance. You’ll be the central point of accountability for the onboarding timeline, progress tracking, risk mitigation, and issue resolution.

The OBM does not sit behind a dashboard reporting on other people’s progress; the OBM makes things happen.

Stepping in is a judgement call, not a default. You step in to unblock delivery, protect a milestone, or build capability in a school that does not yet have it – not to permanently absorb work that belongs to a function or a region, as it covers every function involved in bringing a school into ISP.

You proactively business partner with the School Leadership team on one side, and the Regional, Divisional and Group functions on the other, facilitating both sides to work as one. You translate the group onboarding plan into something a school can deliver, and you translate the school’s reality back into decisions, escalations and support from the region and Group.

You will be structured, credible with senior level stakeholders, comfortable challenging functions and regions, and capable of holding a complex plan together across multiple countries, languages and time zones – while remaining close enough to the detail to deliver it yourself when that is what the school needs.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary link between Group Business Development, regional leadership, and school teams, ensuring sharing of key information and objectives post-acquisition.
  • Work with Group Heads of Function to ensure onboarding task lists are actionable, prioritised, and well understood by operational teams.
  • Facilitate interdepartmental collaboration to align on key tasks, timelines, and deliverables, encouraging open communication and timely issue resolution.
  • Support a culture of continual learning and sharing by facilitating knowledge transfer sessions and contributing to onboarding process refinement.

Regional Management & Regional Support:

  • Lead the development of customised onboarding project plans in monday.com for each school, ensuring alignment with ISP’s integration framework and timelines.
  • Guide regional and school teams in understanding their onboarding responsibilities and deliverables.
  • Monitor progress across all functional areas, identifying delays early, assessing risks and impacts and coordinating with stakeholders to implement corrective measures.
  • Provide practical assistance and support in completing assigned, time-critical tasks where there are capacity or capability challenges.
  • Work closely with the Regional Managing Director & Senior Onboarding Manager to prioritise resource allocation and manage project load to ensure timely delivery of all onboarding milestones.

Integration Planning & Execution:

  • Review Financial Investment Papers (FIPs), Sale & Purchase Agreements (SPAs), core M&A Due Diligences (DD’s) and other acquisition documentation to ensure critical obligations and timelines are captured in the onboarding plan.
  • Tailor integration task lists across departments including HR, Finance, Learning, Marketing, Technology, Legal, and Operations to reflect each school’s structure, priorities and dependencies.
  • Collaborate with other Onboarding Managers and Group Heads of Function to regularly review and improve the integration task library, embedding best practices and feedback from prior projects. International Schools Partnership - General Document
  • Conduct regular status meetings to track progress, manage interdependencies, and ensure that regional and school teams are supported throughout the onboarding lifecycle.
  • Proactively escalate material risks and propose mitigation actions to ensure minimal disruption to school operations and the project timeline.

PMO tool (Monday.com) Administration & Reporting:

  • Maintain and update our project management tool, currently monday.com, on boards for all active projects, ensuring they reflect real-time status, deadlines, and dependencies.
  • Provide guidance and training to regional and school staff on monday.com to support adoption and effective use, as well as project inclusion for all key stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain real-time dashboards and produce regular status reports and updates for regional leadership and ISP Group executives.
  • Ensure consistency and transparency in reporting to support strategic decision-making and highlight areas needing additional support.

Essential skills

  • Cross-functional leadership. Ability to coordinate 15+ functional teams, across multiple schools teams each with its own timelines, dependencies and regulatory requirements.
  • Structured planning and dependency management. Builds and maintains the master onboarding plan, sequencing complex interdependent tasks
  • Risk identification and mitigation. Proactively surfaces risks across all workstreams (regulatory filings, safer recruitment, tax liabilities, property compliance) and drives mitigation actions.
  • Stakeholder communication and governance. Ensures clear, consistent communication between Group, Regional and School stakeholders; facilitates governance meetings and decision-making.
  • Change management. Supports the school through transitions to new systems, policies, reporting structures and compliance expectations.
  • Documentation and reporting. Maintains accurate records, meeting minutes, onboarding reports and audit ready documentation.
  • Hands-on delivery. Comfortable working in the detail and completing tasks personally when a school or function is blocked, rather than only tracking and escalating.

Success measures / KPIs Including, but not limited to:

  • Time to integrate (number of days from completion to final stage gate)
  • Milestone adherence (%)
  • Service standard adherence (% of SLA commitments met per acquisition)
  • Quality of execution (number of reported issues / escalations)
  • Reporting accuracy and timeliness (%)
  • Stakeholder satisfaction, including Head of School and RMD feedback (NPS or score)
  • Lessons learned / process improvement implementation rate (%)

Experience, qualifications and skills

  • Education and experience. +3 Years Experience in project management, mergers & acquisitions and/or post merger integration, preferably within a multi-regional or international organization. A professional qualification and/or master’s degree in business administration, project management or a related field is highly desirable.
  • Technical skills. Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools, especially monday.com, allied to confident, practical use of AI and large language models to accelerate document and due diligence review, drafting, analysis and reporting – applied with sound judgement on data confidentiality and verification of outputs. Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel for analysis and tracking and PowerPoint for executive reporting.
  • Technology and data. Working familiarity with the ISP system landscape (Workday, NetSuite, iSAMS, ClassLink, HubSpot) is an advantage. Comfortable working with data across systems: structuring and reconciling data sets, understanding how school data flows into group reporting, and building and maintaining dashboards from a single source of truth. Exposure to data warehouse or data lake environments, Power BI (DAX Language), and any scripting or workflow automation experience (SQL, Python, Power Automate) is desirable rather than essential. International Schools Partnership - General Document
  • Commercial, legal and financial literacy. Sufficient financial literacy to run the finance workstream credibly with an RFD and a School Business Manager, understand Due Diligence technical reports and legal deal terms.
  • Communication skills. Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to influence, present to senior audiences and build collaborative relationships at all levels.
  • Change management. Demonstrated experience guiding teams through cultural and operational change in a fast-paced, acquisitive environment.
  • Languages. Fluent English is essential. Additional languages are highly desirable depending on the region.
  • Teamwork and independence. Able to work independently while operating effectively in cross-functional, multicultural and multi-time-zone teams.
  • Adaptability. Flexibility to adapt to different working styles, organizational structures and changing project demands.

ISP commitment to safeguarding principles

ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

ISP commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging

ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Regional President - Latin America
description:
The Opportunity

A leading international provider of testing, inspection, laboratory and life sciences services is seeking a senior executive to lead and accelerate the next phase of its Latin American business.

This is a newly formalized regional leadership position with responsibility for a multi-country platform generating approximately €60–70 million in annual revenue , with its principal operations currently concentrated in Brazil, Chile and Colombia .

The successful candidate will take ownership of the regional strategy, performance and development agenda, acting as the senior bridge between the Latin American businesses and the Group's European executive leadership.

This is a CEO-level operating mandate within a larger international organization. The successful individual will be expected to operate with significant autonomy, make independent investment and resource-allocation decisions, lead senior country teams and develop the platform through a combination of organic growth, operational improvement and strategic M&A .

The business is entering an important period of development, with an initial focus on expansion and acquisitions across Latin America followed by increasing emphasis on integration, optimization and consolidation.

The Business

The Latin American platform operates primarily across food testing and laboratory services , with additional activities spanning areas including:

  • Agriculture and agri-food
  • Biopharmaceutical and life sciences
  • Clinical and diagnostic services
  • Environmental testing
  • Genomics and related scientific services
  • Other specialized laboratory and technical services

The organization operates through a decentralized and highly entrepreneurial model, with technically strong local teams and established operations across multiple countries.

The opportunity is to connect these businesses more effectively at a regional level while preserving the local expertise and entrepreneurial culture that underpin their success.

The Role

The Regional President will have broad responsibility for the strategy, P&L, growth, operational performance and organizational development of the Latin American platform .

The role will work closely with country leadership teams and senior Group executives in Europe, while providing a clear regional perspective on investment, acquisitions, market development and organizational priorities.

The position is expected to evolve as the wider regional leadership structure develops, but the successful candidate will operate at approximately CEO-2 level within the broader Group structure and will have substantial exposure to the executive committee.

Key responsibilities

Regional Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute the medium- and long-term strategy for the Latin American business.
  • Establish clear priorities across Brazil, Chile, Colombia and other markets within the regional portfolio.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the platform organically and through strategic investment.
  • Act as the principal link between Latin American operations and European Group leadership.
  • Develop a cohesive regional leadership culture while maintaining appropriate local autonomy.

P&L & Operational Management

  • Hold overall responsibility for the regional P&L and financial performance.
  • Drive revenue growth, profitability, cash generation and return on invested capital.
  • Allocate resources and capital across countries and business lines according to strategic priorities.
  • Ensure operational performance, service quality and customer development remain aligned with regional objectives.
  • Establish appropriate performance metrics and accountability across the country portfolio.

M&A & Business Development

  • Lead the identification and evaluation of acquisition opportunities across Latin America.
  • Develop acquisition strategies aligned with the broader regional growth plan.
  • Work closely with Group M&A, finance and executive leadership on due diligence, valuation and investment decisions.
  • Lead or oversee post-acquisition integration and organizational alignment.
  • Identify opportunities for consolidation and platform-building within fragmented markets.
  • Balance acquisition-led expansion with organic development and operational optimization.

Organizational Development

  • Lead and develop senior country and functional leadership teams.
  • Establish the organizational structure required to support the next phase of regional growth.
  • Build stronger collaboration and knowledge-sharing between countries.
  • Identify and develop future regional and country leadership talent.
  • Operate effectively within a decentralized, matrixed international organization.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong relationships with European executive leadership and Group functions.
  • Represent the Latin American business at senior executive level.
  • Develop relationships with major customers, partners, regulators and other external stakeholders.
  • Navigate differing regulatory, cultural and commercial environments across multiple Latin American markets.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an experienced regional CEO, President, Managing Director or senior General Manager who has previously operated with broad commercial, operational and financial responsibility across Latin America.

We are particularly interested in executives who combine regional P&L ownership with strategic and M&A experience .

Essential experience

  • Significant senior leadership experience across Latin America , ideally with responsibility for multiple countries.
  • Demonstrable experience managing a substantial P&L and full business performance.
  • Experience operating at CEO, President, Regional MD or comparable level.
  • Strong strategic planning and capital-allocation experience.
  • Meaningful experience with M&A, acquisitions and post-acquisition integration .
  • Experience developing businesses through both organic growth and inorganic expansion.
  • Proven ability to operate across different cultures, regulatory environments and business models.
  • Experience leading senior management teams across geographically dispersed operations.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen.

Preferred background

Experience in one or more of the following environments would be highly relevant:

  • Testing, Inspection & Certification
  • Laboratory services
  • Food testing / food safety
  • Environmental testing
  • Life sciences / biopharma services
  • Clinical or diagnostic services
  • Agriculture and agri-food services
  • Technical or scientific services
  • Other decentralized B2B services businesses with comparable complexity

Direct experience in testing or laboratory services is advantageous but not essential for the right regional operator.

Leadership Characteristics

The successful candidate will be a highly autonomous and commercially minded leader who is comfortable operating without unlimited resources or centralized support.

They will demonstrate:

  • Entrepreneurial leadership – able to build and develop a regional platform rather than simply manage an established structure.
  • Strategic thinking – able to translate a broad regional opportunity into a practical investment and growth strategy.
  • Financial discipline – comfortable owning a P&L, allocating capital and making difficult investment decisions.
  • M&A orientation – able to identify, assess and integrate businesses as part of a broader consolidation strategy.
  • Operational credibility – capable of engaging with technical and operational leaders while maintaining a strategic perspective.
  • Cultural intelligence – comfortable leading across different Latin American countries and working with European stakeholders.
  • Decisiveness – comfortable making independent decisions within a complex matrix environment.
  • Influence – able to align decentralized businesses and senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.

Location & Travel

São Paulo is the preferred location , reflecting the scale and strategic importance of the Brazilian business.

Candidates based elsewhere in Latin America, including Buenos Aires, Santiago or other major regional hubs , may also be considered where the leadership profile is particularly strong.

The position will involve regular travel across Latin America and interaction with senior European leadership, including stakeholders based in Brussels and other European locations.

Compensation

A competitive executive package comprising:

  • Base salary
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Long-term incentive / LTI

The final package will be determined according to the experience and seniority of the successful candidate and the employing structure.

Selection Process

The process is expected to include:

  1. Initial video interview with senior Group leadership.
  2. Second-stage interview with the current senior leader responsible for Latin America.
  3. Executive assessment in Brussels , involving meetings with members of the Group executive committee and relevant senior stakeholders.
  4. Finance / P&L case study designed to assess financial and commercial decision-making capability.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity for a senior executive to take genuine ownership of the development of a significant Latin American platform within a highly successful international group.

The mandate combines:

Regional CEO-level autonomy + €60–70m P&L + multi-country leadership + significant M&A + European executive exposure.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to shape the regional organization, determine where and how the business invests, build the next generation of leadership and play a central role in the consolidation and expansion of a growing Latin American services platform.

About the role

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento (P&D) para liderar a área de Food Protection no segmento de carnes. Esta posição será responsável pela gestão da equipe de Aplicação e P&D, liderando projetos de desenvolvimento, validação e implementação de soluções de preservação e extensão de vida útil para clientes da indústria cárnea.

Trata-se de uma posição com potencial de sucessão para uma função mais estratégica no futuro.

Key responsibilities

  • Atuar em uma posição estratégica que combina sólida expertise técnica, liderança de equipe e gestão de projetos, sendo responsável por conduzir iniciativas de desenvolvimento e inovação no segmento de carnes (food protection).

  • Gerenciar simultaneamente projetos de média e alta complexidade, garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades de clientes, objetivos de negócio e execução técnica.

  • Coordenar atividades de laboratório, planta-piloto e testes industriais.
  • Gerenciar projetos de média e alta complexidade, desde a concepção até a implementação comercial.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, reformulações e soluções para o segmento cárneo.
  • Validar tecnologias e soluções da empresa em diferentes categorias de carnes.
  • Atuar como referência técnica em tecnologias de preservação, shelf life, rendimento, sistemas de cobertura, sabor e otimização de formulações.
  • Transformar tendências de mercado, consumo e regulamentação em oportunidades de inovação.
  • Liderar apresentações, workshops técnicos e treinamentos para clientes internos e externos.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com diferentes stakeholders, incluindo clientes, áreas comerciais, marketing, diretoria e times globais.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Marketing, Business Development, Comercial, Supply Chain, Operações e Qualidade para acelerar projetos.
  • Promover uma cultura de inovação, colaboração, adaptação e melhoria contínua.
  • Liderar iniciativas de eficiência operacional e aprimoramento de processos.
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos de qualidade, segurança de alimentos e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar o crescimento da área por meio de visão estratégica e foco na geração de valor para o negócio.

Qualifications and skills

  • Graduação em Engenharia de Alimentos, Ciência dos Alimentos, Tecnologia de Alimentos, Engenharia Química, Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, Especialização, MBA ou Mestrado serão considerados diferenciais.
  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, Aplicação ou áreas técnicas relacionadas ao mercado de carnes.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de ingredientes, aditivos ou soluções para a indústria cárnea, ou atuação técnica em indústrias do setor.
  • Vivência em diferentes categorias de carnes, como embutidos, empanados, hambúrgueres e produtos processados.
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes diretas ou indiretas.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de preservação, shelf life e Food Protection.
  • Conhecimento em microbiologia e segurança de alimentos será considerado diferencial.
  • Experiência em condução simultânea de múltiplos projetos e prioridades.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Espanhol intermediário.
  • Excelente comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Capacidade de influência e gestão de stakeholders em diversos níveis organizacionais.
  • Forte orientação ao cliente e foco em resultados.
  • Perfil dinâmico, adaptável e com senso de urgência.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e inovação.
  • Visão estratégica de negócio e desenvolvimento de soluções com impacto comercial.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Advogado II
description:
Sobre a Copel

Somos a Copel, uma das maiores empresas integradas de energia do Brasil com atuação em geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização.

Nossa força vem da nossa gente. Nós criamos as nossas próprias oportunidades e reconhecemos o potencial das pessoas, pois sabemos que cada um pode contribuir e fortalecer ainda mais a equipe.

Acreditamos que diversidade, inclusão e responsabilidade social fazem parte de uma empresa forte e conectada com o futuro. Por isso, promovemos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas, de diferentes origens, gêneros, raças, idades e orientações são bem-vindas.

Buscamos profissionais que querem se desenvolver junto com o negócio e que estejam preparados para grandes desafios: da infraestrutura que move o Brasil às soluções sustentáveis que protegem o amanhã.

Somos feitos de energia e atitude. Venha fazer parte da Copel.

Modelo de atuação: vaga presencial com atuação em Curitiba/PR.

Sobre da vaga:

Buscamos profissional para atuar no contencioso relacionado à responsabilidade civil da Companhia, com foco em demandas judiciais e administrativas decorrentes da prestação do serviço de energia elétrica, envolvendo acidentes pessoais, danos materiais, danos morais, lucros cessantes, perda de produção, interrupções no fornecimento, oscilações de tensão, queima de equipamentos e demais eventos relacionados às atividades de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia elétrica.

Principais atividades da vaga:

  • Conduzir processos judiciais e administrativos envolvendo responsabilidade civil, incluindo demandas relacionadas a acidentes com energia elétrica, incêndios, eletrocussões, danos a instalações, equipamentos e propriedades de terceiros, bem como que envolvam alegações de lucros cessantes, perda de produção industrial, prejuízos operacionais e interrupções de atividades econômicas decorrentes de falhas, interrupções ou perturbações no sistema elétrico;
  • Atuar na condução das ações judiciais de forma completa, em todos os atos processuais inerentes, como elaboração de peças processuais, participação de audiências, despachos, sustentações orais, recursos a tribunais superiores, etc;
  • Realizar análise jurídica de ocorrências operacionais, relatórios de desligamentos, eventos sistêmicos, registros de rede, laudos periciais e demais documentos necessários à definição das estratégias de defesa;
  • Atuar em negociações e composições judiciais e extrajudiciais, realizando avaliação de riscos, contingências, provisões e impactos financeiros associados às demandas;
  • Elaborar estudos de jurisprudência e acompanhar a evolução da legislação e dos entendimentos dos tribunais sobre responsabilidade civil de concessionárias de energia elétrica.

Requisitos da vaga

  • Graduação em direito e OAB ativa;
  • Experiência na condução de carteiras de direito civil, processual civil e responsabilidade civil.

Habilidades e atitudes:

  • Capacidade analítica para avaliação de questões jurídicas associadas a aspectos técnicos e operacionais do setor elétrico;
  • Visão estratégica de contencioso e gestão de riscos;
  • Capacidade de negociação e condução de casos complexos e de relevância financeira;
  • Boa comunicação e interação com áreas multidisciplinares.

Nossos benefícios:

Na Copel você encontra benefícios pensados para apoiar a sua jornada!

Prêmios por Desempenho (PPD) e Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

Suporte completo para você e sua família com Auxílio Creche, Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida.

Plano de saúde e odontológico completo para você e seus dependentes.

Universidade Corporativa, plataformas de ensino e bolsas de estudo.

Previdência Privada com vantagens exclusivas para quem é Copel.

This is a proper architecture role. You'll have a big say in how data is stored, processed, governed, and accessed across a range of complex products and systems.

You'll be working in a predominantly on-prem environment , including systems that can be air-gapped or disconnected, so this isn't your typical cloud-first data role.

What you'll be getting involved in:

  • Designing a shared Data Platform across multiple products
  • Data lakes, warehouses and data management architecture
  • Building the architecture behind operational, analytics and AI workloads
  • Working with structured, unstructured, time-series, geospatial and binary data
  • Designing for on-prem, air-gapped and low-latency environments
  • Setting standards around governance, security and access control
  • Working closely with engineering teams on the wider technical roadmap

What we're looking for:

  • You'll have experience across data engineering/data architecture and be comfortable making high-level architectural decisions while still understanding what it takes to build and operate these systems.
  • Strong experience across databases, distributed processing, messaging, orchestration, and data governance is important.
  • Experience in defence, government, utilities, critical infrastructure, or other mission-critical environments would be particularly interesting.
  • Please note this role requires you to work onsite in Abu Dhabi

title: Coordenador fiscal
description:
A TVH Latam , referência em seu segmento, está em busca de um Coordenador Fiscal para atuar em nossa unidade de Vinhedo/SP .

Procuramos um profissional com forte perfil tático e analítico, que será o elo entre a estratégia do negócio e a execução operacional, liderando a nossa equipe fiscal e garantindo a acurácia dos nossos processos tributários e a correta parametrização do ERP Protheus.

O que você fará no dia a dia

  • Distribuir demandas, estabelecer prioridades e acompanhar tecnicamente a equipe de analistas e assistentes nas apurações e obrigações acessórias (SPED, EFD Contribuições, REINF, MIT, DCTF-Web).
  • Validar memórias de cálculo, restituições e MVA/IVA-ST para autopeças, além de controlar a aplicação prática de benefícios fiscais (TTD 410, TTS, Prodepe).
  • Atuar na ponta operacional do projeto de transição da Reforma Tributária (IBS/CBS), mapeando processos, implementando diretrizes e conduzindo testes no Configurador de Tributos do ERP.
  • Analisar a carga tributária de importações e dar suporte diário às áreas de Compras e Pricing na formação de preços e composição de custos.
  • Mapear oportunidades de automação, reduzir retrabalhos e garantir o levantamento de dados e documentos para fiscalizações e auditorias.

O que buscamos em você

  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou Direito. Pós-graduação ou especialização em Direito ou Gestão Tributária será um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Vivência consolidada em rotinas fiscais no segmento de revenda/atacado. Ideal para Analistas Seniores em transição para liderança ou profissionais que já atuam como Coordenadores/Supervisores.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Forte base na legislação de impostos indiretos, ICMS-ST e incentivos fiscais estaduais.
  • Sistemas: Domínio do ERP Protheus (especialmente rotinas de TES e livros fiscais) é considerado um grande diferencial.
  • Perfil: Organização, capacidade analítica, visão de processos, excelente comunicação e habilidade para desenvolver e engajar o time operacional.

Benefícios:

✅ Assistência médica e odontológica;

✅ Seguro de Vida;

✅ Previdência Privada (aporte da empresa de até 6%);

✅ Bolsa Estudo (conforme a política da empresa);

✅ Refeição na empresa (desjejum e almoço);

✅ Vale Alimentação;

✅ Auxílio Mobilidade ou VT;

✅ Presente de Aniversário;

✅ Bem-estar: Ginástica Laboral, Wellhub;

✅ Ações de Endomarketing;

✅ 2 dias de Day Off por ano;

✅ Modelo Híbrido - 4 x 1 (4 na empresa e 1 home office)

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas - Ribeirão Preto - SP - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Religião, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQ+, Etnia e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa. Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Analista de Atração e Seleção Júnior (Temporário)
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Realizar processos de atração e seleção para vagas operacionais e administrativas em alto volume;
  • Divulgar oportunidades em diferentes canais de recrutamento;
  • Realizar triagem e análise de currículos;
  • Conduzir entrevistas individuais e coletivas, presenciais e/ou online;
  • Aplicar e acompanhar etapas de avaliação conforme o processo seletivo;

  • Realizar o lançamento e fechamento mensal de refeições consumidas na Unidade, bem como gerar relatório gerencial que demonstre toda movimentação;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento do orçamento da Unidade, previsto x realizado, monitorando o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos do setor;
  • Planejar e organizar coffee breaks e eventos, visando garantir a qualidade do serviço e o atendimento adequado às demandas da unidade.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino superior completo em Nutrição;
  • Vivência prática em gestão de cozinha industrial com liderança de equipe - UAN;
  • CRN Ativo;
  • CNH Ativa;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Software Genial, SAP e Gestão da Rotina;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em São José do Rio Preto, Tanabi, Monte Aprazível ou Mirassol.

O que buscamos em um profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 10.700 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana- de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 8 países, 36 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.600 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2024/25, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de €5,9 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas seis unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Analista Pleno de Visual Merchandising & Store Design | LATAM
description:
Estamos conduzindo uma oportunidade para atuar em uma estrutura regional de Visual Merchandising & Store Design , com projetos para diferentes marcas e mercados da América Latina.

Buscamos um profissional hands-on, executor e detalhista , com forte experiência em Design e Visual Merchandising, que tenha facilidade para transformar conceitos e guidelines de marca em soluções práticas e acompanhar os projetos de ponta a ponta.

Sobre a posição

O profissional atuará principalmente em projetos de Visual Merchandising , apoiando também iniciativas de Store Design e projetos estratégicos para diferentes marcas da região.

Será responsável por transformar guidelines e conceitos já definidos em propostas e soluções de design, trabalhando em parceria com o time regional e diferentes stakeholders.

  • Desenvolver apresentações e propostas de design;
  • Apoiar projetos estratégicos de Visual Merchandising e Store Design;
  • Atuar na solução de problemas de design, buscando alternativas viáveis e alinhadas às diretrizes da marca;
  • Acompanhar os projetos de forma end-to-end , garantindo ownership das entregas;
  • Trabalhar com múltiplos projetos e prazos simultaneamente;
  • Interagir com diferentes áreas e stakeholders regionais.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Design, Design Industrial, Design Gráfico ou Arquitetura ;
  • Experiência profissional em Visual Merchandising, Retail Design, Store Design ou áreas correlatas ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e execução de projetos;

  • Conhecimento de Office;

  • Inglês será considerado um diferencial, mas não é eliminatório .

O que buscamos:

Um profissional:

  • Executor e hands-on ;
  • Proativo e com senso de ownership;
  • Organizado e detalhista;
  • Ágil e acostumado a trabalhar com prazos curtos e pressão ;
  • Com boa capacidade de comunicação;
  • Que saiba tomar decisões e propor soluções;
  • Com olhar apurado para design;
  • Que tenha autonomia para conduzir projetos do início ao fim;
  • Que não tenha receio de perguntar, pedir ajuda ou sinalizar dificuldades antes que elas se transformem em problemas.

A criatividade é importante, mas principalmente como capacidade de solucionar problemas, adaptar conceitos e encontrar alternativas , e não necessariamente como criação de conceitos do zero.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência em agências de design, branding, comunicação, retail ou visual merchandising ;
  • Experiência nos segmentos de varejo, beauty, cosméticos ou luxo ;
  • Vivência com projetos para grandes marcas;
  • Experiência em ambientes regionais ou multinacionais.

Profissionais vindos de agência são especialmente bem-vindos, principalmente aqueles acostumados a trabalhar com projetos completos, múltiplos clientes, prazos desafiadores e alto nível de execução .

Sobre o time

Você fará parte de uma estrutura regional que atua a partir do Brasil e México e atende os mercados da América Latina, em um ambiente colaborativo, independente e com forte troca de conhecimento entre os profissionais.

Local: Zona Sul - SP

Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido, 2x presencial.

Salários e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.

Se você tem experiência em Design + Visual Merchandising , gosta de colocar a mão na massa e busca atuar em projetos regionais e para marcas de grande relevância, essa oportunidade pode fazer sentido para você.

title: Gerente de Área
description:
A Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país. Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída. Guiada pelos pilares de inovação, sustentabilidade, saudabilidade e excelência, a Fugini foi pioneira no lançamento de embalagens do tipo sachê para a linha de atomatados - uma das mais eficazes e seguras para a preservação dos alimentos - e a primeira no mundo a embalar vegetais nesse formato. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações. Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acesse fugini.com.br .

Posição: Gerente de Área Vendas - São Paulo Interior

O que buscamos:

✔ Experiência sólida em indústria varejo alimentar;

✔ Conhecimento amplo no atendimento de clientes no canal varejo , atacado e distribuidores de pequeno e médio porte;

✔ Habilidade em gestão de indicadores, análise de informações e tomada de decisão estratégica;

✔ Capacidade para desenvolver campanhas comerciais e planos de negócio junto aos clientes;

✔ Liderança para acompanhar equipes de Empresários Representantes Comerciais e ações de marketing;

✔ Estruturação de equipes (montagem e desenvolvimento de equipes);

✔ Importante ter atuado profissionalmente na região de Bauru no interior do estado de São Paulo;

✔ Residir na cidade de Bauru/SP.

Principais desafios:

Monitorar performance de produtos e garantir execução no PDV;

Acompanhar lojas, estoques e distribuição;

Ativar materiais de PDV conforme prioridades do ciclo comercial;

Montar e desenvolver equipe de Empresários Representantes Comerciais.

title: Analista de compras

  • Conhecimento em Strategic Sourcing e gestão de fornecedores.

title: Cross Border Tech Compliance Adviso
description:
Role Description The Cross Border Tech Compliance Advisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Valparaíso de Goiás, GO. This role focuses on advising SFAP community members and partner organizations on technology-related compliance requirements affecting cross-border finance and accounting activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring relevant regulations and standards, preparing guidance materials, and reviewing processes to ensure adherence to data protection, cybersecurity, and fintech compliance norms. The Advisor will collaborate with stakeholders to assess risk, recommend controls for technology platforms and tools, and support the implementation of compliant workflows. The role also involves conducting awareness sessions and drafting reports, policies, and procedures that are clear, practical, and aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong knowledge of cross-border compliance, including regulatory frameworks relevant to finance, accounting, and technology-enabled services.
  • Candidates should possess skills in technology risk assessment, data protection practices, and cybersecurity principles related to financial systems and digital platforms.
  • Candidates should possess the ability to analyze complex regulations, interpret legal and technical requirements, and translate them into practical policies and procedures.
  • Candidates should possess effective communication skills, including the capacity to prepare clear documentation, deliver training sessions, and engage with diverse stakeholders.
  • Candidates should possess strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Relevant experience in compliance, audit, or advisory roles within finance, accounting, or fintech environments is beneficial.
  • A bachelor’s degree in law, finance, accounting, information systems, or a related field is preferred; professional certifications in compliance, risk management, or data protection are a plus.
  • Familiarity with regional and international regulatory bodies, cross-border data transfer rules, and industry best practices in governance and ethics is advantageous.

title: Coordenador de logística

Sobre a Empresa

A IDV é especializada no desenvolvimento e fornecimento de soluções veiculares e de proteção para o setor de defesa. title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Gerenciamento de Operações
description:
A AEL está em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Gerenciamento de Operações. A posição garante o alinhamento entre a demanda dos clientes, a capacidade produtiva, a disponibilidade de materiais e as prioridades operacionais, apoiando a execução bem-sucedida dos projetos e o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega. Como Coordenador(a), seu foco será a liderança, o desenvolvimento e a gestão de uma equipe, assegurando alinhamento, responsabilidade e excelência na execução de todas as atividades de planejamento.

Nessa posição você terá o desafio:

  • Liderar as atividades de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP), garantindo a execução dos cronogramas de fabricação e o atendimento aos compromissos com os clientes dentro dos prazos;
  • Impulsionar o desempenho dos estoques por meio da otimização de inventário, gestão da saúde dos estoques e controle de materiais excedentes e obsoletos;
  • Monitorar e melhorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), incluindo OTD (On-Time Delivery), TAT (Turnaround Time), desempenho de estoque e eficácia do planejamento;
  • Liderar iniciativas multifuncionais de planejamento e melhoria contínua para aumentar a prontidão da produção, o desempenho operacional, a produtividade, a eficiência de custos e a execução das entregas;
  • Atuar como principal interface entre a AEL e a Elbit Systems em demandas da área;
  • Atuar na integração entre as áreas de Operações, Engenharia, Gerenciamento de Programas, Qualidade, Supply Chain e Manufatura, garantindo alinhamento e tomada de decisão eficiente.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas, Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos, Gestão de Operações ou área correlatas;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação);
  • Sólida experiência gerenciando atividades de planejamento em ambiente operacional;
  • Sólida experiência gerenciando e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Excel;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle da Produção, Planejamento de materiais (MRP), planejamento de demanda e suprimentos.

O que a AEL te proporciona:

  • Política de horários flexível e modelo híbrido: Atuamos com banco de horas e alguns dias de atuação remota, proporcionando uma rotina flexível;
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed: Custos de adesão subsidiados pela AEL;
  • Seguro de Vida: Zelamos pela sua proteção e de seus familiares;
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeitório: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefícios Flash e contamos com refeitório na empresa;
  • Auxílio Mobilidade/Vale Transporte: Facilitamos o seu deslocamento diário com opções que se adaptam à sua rotina;
  • Estimulamos o equilíbrio da vida pessoal e profissional: Temos um calendário anual de feriados e férias coletivas, visando estimular o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional;
  • Celebramos nossas conquistas: temos diversas ações de confraternização e reconhecimento, celebrando os atingimentos da jornada;
  • Auxílio idioma: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento através do aprimoramento em inglês;
  • Prêmio de fim de ano: Reconhecemos os desafios atingidos ao fim do ano;
  • Incentivos à prática de atividades físicas: Investimos na sua saúde através de grupos de corrida, ginástica funcional e ginástica laboral;
  • Bebê AEL: Celebramos a chegada de novos membros das famílias;
  • Empresa Cidadã: Contamos com dias estendidos de licença maternidade e paternidade.

Sobre a AEL Sistemas:

Excelência faz parte da nossa cultura. Está em tudo o que fazemos, nos processos, na forma de ser e inovar. A cada dia, o nosso potencial criativo se materializa na tecnologia de ponta que desenvolvemos. Aqui valorizamos as relações humanas, amigáveis e plurais, identificando os momentos em que é preciso seguir a formalidade e reforçar a nossa experiência.

Somos uma empresa genuinamente brasileira. Desde 2001 fazemos parte de um dos maiores conglomerados de defesa mundial: o Grupo Elbit Systems. E isso nos torna únicos: temos uma essência local, com presença e tecnologia global.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Job Overview: 

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.

Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention

  • Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.
  • Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.
  • Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.
  • Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.
  • Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.
  • Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.
  • Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.
  • Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.
  • Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.
  • Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.
  • Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.
  • Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.
  • Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.
  • Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.
  • Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.
  • Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.
  • Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.
  • Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.
  • Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.
  • Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).
  • Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.

Collaboration

  • Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.
  • Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.
  • Monitor students’ progress and well-being.
  • Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.
  • Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.
  • Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.
  • Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.
  • Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.
  • Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.
  • Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.

Operational and Professional Conduct

  • Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.
  • Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.
  • Maintain accurate student records.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities.
  • Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.
  • Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.
  • Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide .

Other duties, as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • Walk on paths and rough terrain
  • May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:  

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required:

  • Five years of teaching experience, preferred
  • Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.
  • Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge:

  • Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.
  • Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.
  • Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.
  • Collegial and collaborative.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Senior Specialist - Forest Fire Management, Technology & Innovation
description:
At APP Group, we’re not just supplying sustainable paper and packaging, we’re reshaping the future of responsible business. As one of the world’s largest integrated pulp and paper companies, with over 100,000 employees delivering products to more than 150 countries, APP Group combines global scale with local agility.

We are looking for a Senior Specialist – Forest Fire Management, Technology & Innovation to lead the development of research, innovation, technology, systems, and Fire Management solutions to support the improvement of Integrated Fire Management (IFM) implementation, covering Fire Prevention, Fire Readiness, Early Detection, and Rapid Response.

This role is responsible for identifying, evaluating, developing, and applying technology-based, data-driven, analytical, and international best-practice solutions to enhance the organization's ability to prevent, detect, and respond to forest and land fires, while protecting company assets and supporting business sustainability.

The successful Senior Specialist – Forest Fire Management, Technology & Innovation will be based in Jakarta, Indonesia with high mobility to Regions, Groups, Districts and Operational Areas.

1. Strategic Development: Support the development of the company’s long-term Fire Management strategy by identifying global best practices, emerging trends and opportunities for improved IFM effectiveness.

6. Organizational Development Support: Strengthen Fire Management capabilities through improved standards, methodologies, technology competencies, innovation and knowledge sharing across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a professional who can integrate Fire Management + Forestry Operations + Technology + GIS & Remote Sensing + Data & Analytics + Innovation and translate technological developments into practical solutions that can be applied to enhance the effectiveness of fire prevention, preparedness, early detection, and firefighting in plantation and forest areas.

Required Technical Skills:

title: Expert YugabyteDB Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Expert YugabyteDB Database Engineer (DBE)

Database Engineer (DBE) - Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (preferred South / Central America or US time zones)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database Support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open-source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks, YugabyteDB, and other emerging technologies. Our customers run mission-critical, high-volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We are a small, world-class expert, remote-first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

Role Overview

As an Expert Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production, with an emphasis on supporting YugabyteDB clusters. You will dive deep into query optimization, transaction throughput, schema and sharding design, replication, and HA/DR configuration. Your job is to ensure that large-scale distributed SQL systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.

While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills. Knowledge of DevOps, infrastructure, security, or SRE practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in YugabyteDB and other distributed SQL / OLTP database clusters (transaction contention and conflicts, query regressions, tablet hotspots, replication lag, compaction stalls, connection saturation).
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, sharding and indexing strategies, connection pooling, and configs to maximize efficiency under high read and write load. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE and execution plans on the YSQL (PostgreSQL-compatible) layer.
  • Architecture and design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, primary key and sharding design, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches including synchronous replication, xCluster asynchronous replication, read replicas, and geo-distributed deployments.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation).
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.
  • Additional PostgreSQL proficiency is a big plus.
  • Open-source contributions to yugabyteDB.
  • C/C++ skills.

Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting YugabyteDB clusters in larger-scale production (not just querying or application usage; no PoCs).
  • Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema and sharding design, and transaction throughput tuning.
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts ( consistency, Raft consensus, replication, failover, scaling).
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups.
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics, and SQL (PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred given YugabyteDB's YSQL compatibility).
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios).
  • Strong English language communication skills , able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing.
  • English language fluency
  • Bonus : Experience with PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, TiDB, Google Spanner, Apache Cassandra, Vitess, or similar distributed SQL / OLTP databases.
  • Bonus : Experience with Apache Druid, StarRocks, Clickhouse, Apache Doris or similar distributed SQL / OLAP databases.
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to Yugabyte open-source database projects.
  • Bonus: C/C++ Skills

What We Offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases and communities.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions.
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment, via a global payroll partner, or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

Location and Working Style

  • Remote-first. We collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Remote EOIR Immigration Paralegal - Trilingual (Portuguese, Spanish & English)
description:
About Us

Brooks Law P.C. is one of the fastest-growing law firms in Massachusetts, representing immigrants and injury victims with offices in Medford, Framingham and New Hampshire.

We are a technology-forward firm with a fully remote, globally distributed support team. If you are an experienced immigration professional who wants to put your skills to work helping immigrants from anywhere in the world, we want to meet you.

About the Job

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced EOIR Immigration Paralegal fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English to join our immigration law team. The ideal candidate will have at least 2 years of immigration paralegal experience , with a strong preference for candidates who have hands-on experience with EOIR proceedings and removal defense cases .

Experience handling removal defense, asylum, cancellation of removal, adjustment of status, motions to reopen or reconsider, Master Calendar Hearings, and Individual Hearings is highly preferred.

The successful candidate is proactive, organized, dependable, and capable of taking ownership of an active caseload in a fast-paced immigration law environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with both clients and attorneys are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage an assigned caseload of EOIR and removal defense cases.
  • Prepare and organize filings for Immigration Court and EOIR for attorney review.
  • Assist with applications for relief from removal, including asylum, cancellation of removal, adjustment of status, and other forms of relief.
  • Prepare and assist with Motions to Reopen, Motions to Reconsider, Motions to Change Venue, Motions for Continuance, and other court filings.
  • Track Master Calendar Hearings, Individual Hearings, filing deadlines, and other court-related deadlines.
  • Review Notices to Appear, hearing notices, court orders, decisions, and other EOIR correspondence.
  • Assist attorneys with hearing preparation by organizing evidence, exhibits, applications, and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare and maintain organized case exhibits and filing packages.
  • Communicate with clients regarding upcoming hearings, required documents, case updates, and deadlines.
  • Follow up with clients to obtain missing documents, evidence, and information needed for their cases.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed case notes and case status updates.
  • Monitor EOIR case information and promptly communicate changes or important updates to the attorney.
  • Ensure all court deadlines and assigned tasks are properly calendared and completed on time.
  • Maintain organized electronic case files and ensure all documents are properly uploaded and labeled.
  • Communicate effectively with clients and team members through email, phone, and other virtual communication platforms.
  • Perform additional EOIR and removal defense duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of immigration paralegal experience.
  • Previous EOIR and/or Immigration Court experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with removal defense cases required or highly preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and Spanish, with strong English communication skills.
  • Knowledge of Immigration Court procedures and EOIR requirements.
  • Familiarity with Master Calendar and Individual Hearings.
  • Experience preparing immigration court filings and supporting documentation.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet strict deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned cases.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong computer and technology skills.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Starting salary of $900 USD per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  • Paid time off
  • Strong opportunities for growth and advancement within the firm

Work Location and Schedule

  • Location: Fully remote — work from anywhere outside the United States
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Remote work Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a backup connection or contingency plan
  • Personal computer capable of handling video calls, large PDF files, and cloud-based case management software.
  • Quiet, private, professional workspace suitable for confidential client calls and work.
  • Headset with a clear microphone and working webcam.
  • Ability to work consistently during U.S. Eastern business hours.
  • Willingness to sign a confidentiality and data-security agreement covering the handling of sensitive client information.

Why Join Brooks Law?

  • Work directly with experienced U.S. immigration attorneys.
  • Long-term opportunity with a growing Massachusetts law firm.
  • Technology-forward, globally distributed team.

How to Apply

Apply through this posting with your resume in English.In your application, please tell us:

  1. Which languages you speak and your level of fluency in each.
  2. Your EOIR experience, including the types of filings or matters you have handled.

Brooks Law Firm is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Inside Sales & Customer Growth Manager
description:
Location: São Paulo - SP. (Regional scope)

Reports to: Regional Director Brazil & Colombia

Team: Directly manages analysts/executors across four functions (no intermediate leads at this stage), 10 HCs

About the Role

We are looking for a Head Manager of Inside Sales & Customer Growth to lead and structure our Inside Sales operation. This position comes with a clear mission: to become the engine of scalable, replicable, and intelligent customer base growth.

This role currently oversees four distinct functions — inbound lead conversion (hunting), churn account reactivation, remote servicing of small accounts, and sales support — with direct management of each team member.

Mission

Drive scalable, replicable, and intelligent growth of the customer base across the region by directly managing and standardizing the operations of lead conversion, account reactivation, remote account servicing, and commercial support — freeing up the Key Account Management (KAM) team to focus on strategic accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Hunting (Inbound Lead Conversion)

  • Own the process for receiving and converting leads generated through the portal
  • Drive speed-to-lead and improve conversion rate through process discipline and coaching
  • Define and monitor SLAs for response time and follow-up

Churn Reactivation

  • Lead efforts to reactivate churned accounts and recover lost revenue
  • Build a systematic, repeatable approach to identifying and prioritizing reactivation opportunities

Small Accounts (Remote Servicing)

  • Manage remote coverage of small accounts that do not warrant a dedicated KAM
  • Ensure service quality and account growth through efficient, scalable processes

Sales Support

  • Provide operational support to the broader commercial team
  • Ensure fast turnaround and high satisfaction from internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Design and standardize playbooks and processes across all four functions, built to be replicable across countries (Brazil & Colombia)
  • Directly manage, coach, and develop the individuals executing each function
  • Track and report on performance metrics across all four workstreams
  • Partner closely with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and the broader Commercial team to align on lead flow, account handoffs, and shared goals

Success Metrics (6–12 months)

  • Growth in active customer base (%)
  • Standardized, documented processes across all four functions, replicable across countries
  • Improved conversion rate (hunting) and reactivation rate (churn)
  • Team development plan in place, with a clear path toward a squad-lead structure as the operation scales

What We're Looking For

Industry Experience

  • Solid experience in the travel & tourism industry , ideally within online travel platforms (OTAs), booking marketplaces, or tour/travel operators
  • Understanding of how travel distribution works — lead sources, booking cycles, seasonality, and the relationship dynamics between platforms, operators, and agents

Functional / Technical

  • Strong analytical capability — comfortable reading funnel data, conversion metrics, and churn/cohort analysis
  • Process-oriented mindset, with experience designing or improving operational playbooks

Leadership

  • People management experience, ideally across diverse functions or a fast-changing environment
  • Execution discipline — able to drive rhythm, accountability, and results
  • Strong negotiation and cross-functional influence skills — this role depends heavily on alignment with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and Sales

Behavioral

  • Builder mindset — comfortable structuring a function from the ground up in a lean, still-forming regional operation
  • Autonomy and comfort with ambiguity
  • Cultural adaptability, with an eye toward managing teams across multiple countries as the role expands

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Customer Growth roles
  • Experience operating in a regional or multi-country context
  • Portuguese, Spanish and English fluency, given the Brazil & Colombia scope

• Experiência comprovada em projetos de sistemas de água e esgoto (nível pleno);

• Domínio de AutoCAD (2D) para elaboração de projetos;

• Conhecimento das normas técnicas da ABNT aplicáveis a saneamento (NBR 12211, 12212, 12218, 9648, 9649, entre outras);

• Conhecimento de softwares de dimensionamento hidráulico (ex.: EPANET, SewerCAD/SewerGEMS ou similares)

Principais atividades

• Elaborar projetos de sistemas de abastecimento de água e de esgotamento sanitário (redes, estações elevatórias, ETAs e ETEs), do estudo de concepção ao projeto executivo;

• Desenvolver memoriais de cálculo, memoriais descritivos, plantas, cortes e detalhamentos técnicos;

• Realizar dimensionamento hidráulico de redes e unidades de tratamento;

• Elaborar orçamentos, quantitativos e especificações técnicas associados aos projetos;

• Apoiar a compatibilização de projetos com equipes multidisciplinares (civil, elétrica, ambiental);

• Acompanhar órgãos licenciadores e concessionárias quanto a exigências técnicas e normativas aplicáveis ao saneamento;

• Dar suporte técnico em campo quando necessário (vistorias, levantamentos e acompanhamento de obras).

Sobre a EME

A EME Engenharia Ambiental é uma consultoria ambiental brasileira, sediada em Belo Horizonte (MG), que atua desde 2009 nas áreas de Licenciamento e Gestão Ambiental e de Projetos na área de Saneamento. Buscamos um(a) Analista Projetista de Saneamento Ambiental para fortalecer nossa equipe técnica de projetos de água e esgoto.
